newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Turkmen Jan-Aug trade surplus narrows to $396 mln.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen Jan-Aug trade surplus narrows to $396 mln.

text.p: Turkmenistan posted a trade surplus of $395.90 million in the first eight months of this year after a $413.3 million surplus in the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said on Friday.
TURKMEN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Aug 96 Jan-Jul 96 Jan-Aug 95
Notes -- Figures in billion dollars, FOB.
Commonwealth of Independent States countries accounted to 54 percent of trade turnover, the committee said.
Turkmenistan mostly exports natural gas, raw cotton, oil products and electricity.
